questions.question: By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct? + and -
questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct?

+ and -
questions.solution:
After interchanging '+ and -' in the options, we get:

1. 7 + 5 × 3 - 24 ÷ 6 = 7

⇒ 7 + 5 × 3 - 24 ÷ 6 = 7

⇒ 7 + 5 × 3 - 4 = 7

⇒ 7 + 15 - 4 = 7

⇒ 22 - 4 = 7

⇒ 18 ≠ 7

2. 20 ÷ 4 + 5 × 6 - 3 = 32

⇒ 20 ÷ 4 + 5 × 6 - 3 = 32

⇒ 5 + 5 × 6 - 3 = 32

⇒ 5 + 30 - 3 = 32

⇒ 35 - 3 = 32

⇒ 32 = 32

3. 4 - 5 × 2 + 9 ÷ 3 = 5

⇒ 4 - 5 × 2 + 9 ÷ 3 = 5

⇒ 4 - 5 × 2 + 3 = 5

⇒ 4 - 10 + 3 = 5 

⇒ 7 -10 = 5

⇒ -3 ≠ 5

4. 7 × 3 + 10 - 8 ÷ 2 = 29

⇒ 7 × 3 + 10 - 8 ÷ 2 = 29

⇒ 7 × 3 + 10 - 4 = 29

⇒ 21 + 10 - 4 = 29 

⇒ 31 - 4 = 29

⇒ 27 ≠ 29

Hence, '20 ÷ 4 - 5 × 6 + 3 = 32' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 95 ÷ 19 × 3 – 7 + 29 = 13
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

95 ÷ 19 × 3 – 7 + 29 = 13
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

Given equation: 95 ÷ 19 × 3 – 7 + 29 = 13

1. + and ×

L.H.S =  95 ÷ 19 + 3 – 7 × 29

= 5 + 3 – 7 × 29

= 5 + 3 - 203

= 8 - 203

= -195 ≠ R.H.S

2. – and ×

L.H.S =  95 ÷ 19 - 3 × 7 + 29 

= 5 - 3 × 7 + 29

= 5 - 21 + 29

= 34 - 21

= 13 = R.H.S

3. – and +

L.H.S = 95 ÷ 19 × 3 + 7 - 29

= 5 × 3 + 7 - 29

= 15 + 7 - 29

= 22 - 29

= -7 ≠ R.H.S

4. ÷ and –

L.H.S = 95 - 19 × 3 ÷ 7 + 29 

= 95 - 19 × 0.42 + 29

= 95 - 7.98 + 29

= 124 - 7.98

= 116.02 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, '– and ×' is the correct answer.

Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

16 − 18 × 216 ÷ 432 + 40 = 20
questions.solution:
Given: 16 − 18 × 216 ÷ 432 + 40 = 20

Option 1) × and ÷

After interchanging the mathematical sign we get:

⇒ 16 − 18 ÷ 216 × 432 + 40 = 20

⇒ 16 -  (1/12)× 432 + 40 = 20

⇒ 16 - 36 + 40 = 20

⇒ 56 - 36 = 20

⇒ 20 = 20

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) ÷ and -

After interchanging the mathematical sign we get:

⇒ 16 ÷ 18 × 216 - 432 + 40 = 20 

⇒ 0.888 × 216 - 432 + 40 = 20

⇒ 192 - 432 + 40 = 20

⇒ 232 - 432 = 20

⇒ - 200 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) × and +

After interchanging the mathematical sign we get:

⇒ 16 − 18 + 216 ÷ 432 × 40 = 20 

⇒ 16 - 18 + 0.5 × 40 = 20

⇒ 16 - 18 + 20 = 20

⇒ 36 - 18 = 20

⇒ 18 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) + and −

After interchanging the mathematical sign we get:

⇒ 16 + 18 × 216 ÷ 432 - 40 = 20

⇒ 16 + 18 × 0.5 - 40 = 20

⇒ 16 + 9 - 40 = 20

⇒ 25 - 40 = 20

⇒ - 15 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
